content: 9front added a generic sys/src/9/arm64/ layer (Nov 2023 HUMANBIOLOGICS) shared by bcm64/imx8/qemu kernels, containing a 'qemu' kernel config for qemu -M virt. Files: bootargs.c cache.v8.s clock.c dat.h devrtc.c fns.h fpu.c gic.c init9.s io.h l.s main.c mem.c mem.h mkfile mmu.c pciqemu.c qemu rebootcode.s sysreg.c sysreg.h trap.c uartqemu.c. qemu config uses GIC + PL011 uart (uartqemu) + ECAM PCIe (pciqemu) + virtio (ethervirtio10, sdvirtio10). Booted via u-boot: qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt,gic-version=3 -bios u-boot.bin; kernel linked at 0xffffffffc0100000 (KZERO=0xffffffff80000000, VDRAM=0xffffffffc0000000, phys load 0x40100000), converted to uImage via aux/aout2uimage -Z$kzero. Commit dd798542 (Keegan Saunders, Oct 2023).
